description: This file defines the ContentTranslationManager class, which provides functionality for managing content translation in Drupal, including handling translation support, settings, and moderation support.

classes.name: ContentTranslationManager
classes.description: Provides methods for managing content translation, including support checks, settings, and moderation features.

methods.name: getTranslationHandler
methods.description: Returns the translation handler for a given entity type.

methods.name: getTranslationMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a translation entity.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if content translation is supported for a specific entity type.

methods.name: getSupportedEntityTypes
methods.description: Returns all entity types supported for content translation.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables content translation for a specific entity type and bundle.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if content translation is enabled for a specific entity type and bundle.

methods.name: setBundleTranslationSettings
methods.description: Sets translation settings for a specific bundle.

methods.name: getBundleTranslationSettings
methods.description: Retrieves translation settings for a specific bundle.

methods.name: loadContentLanguageSettings
methods.description: Loads or creates content language settings for an entity type and bundle.

methods.name: isPendingRevisionSupportEnabled
methods.description: Determines if support for pending revisions is enabled, based on module and moderation settings.
